cloud.source: 1.5 km deck to sun, Earth shadow included

elevation_deg.source: Apparent sun elevation, -20 to 90 in 0.5 steps

lobe.source: Horizon toward the sun minus haze

lobe_k.source: Exponent of cos(azimuth) fitted at 45° on luminance

metadata.source: Single scattering through a spherical atmosphere (Rayleigh, Mie, ozone; Bruneton 2017 and Hillaire 2020 Earth constants at 680/550/440 nm) plus Hillaire's isotropic multiple-scattering approximation; no ground reflection (estimate: twilight slightly dark). Relative to a unit top-of-atmosphere sun; anchored in game at 45°.

sun.source: Ground to sun, times the visible disc share

zenith.source: Sky straight up, Mie aureole within 35° of the sun excluded
